release_notes: Refines Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.1 with a more reliable activation experience and a more responsive speaker-identification stage. Incorrect account credentials now show a clear retryable error instead of leaving the activation window stuck, and speaker diarization now runs in a separate process so the desktop interface remains responsive while speakers are identified. Existing Personal/Professional licensing, GPU/CUDA plan enforcement, decoder, reconstruction, offline licensing, and update behavior are preserved.
